description: Solar irrigation Potential in Sub-Saharan Africa: A crop-specific techno-economic analysis is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Agriculture", published or maintained by Nathan Williams, Fhazhil Wamalwa (World Bank Group). This dataset includes annual irrigation water requirements and corresponding irrigation energy needs for the period from 2000 to 2020. Additionally, the dataset provides the estimated annual irrigation yield gain, calculated as the difference between irrigated and rainfed yield within each crop cell, while keeping all other production conditions constant. Coverage: Sub-Saharan Africa. It has 8 files in CSV, DOCX. The portal files it under Agriculture. The portal gives 2025 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
